newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France sees five May 23 cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: Air France sees five May 23 cargo flights.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it expected to maintain five of its eight scheduled Boeing 747-200 freighter flights from Paris tomorrow, May 23, as strike action by the airline's pilots continued.

"Freighter flights from Paris tomorrow serving Chicago, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Kuwait, Delhi, Bangkok, Hong Kong, Taipei and Osaka will be maintained but those serving New York, Miami, Pointe a Pitre, Bogota and Sao Paulo have been cancelled," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
He added that five of Thursday's eight freighter flights were operating normally.

"The strike is due to end from May 24. It is likely that extra 747F flights will be added to handle freight which has been warehoused due freighter cancellations during the past few days," the official said.

The strike, which began on May 20, is a resumption of a walkout that was threatened last month after talks with management broke down over a pay scale which would pay new pilots between nine and 30 percent less than current crews. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
